scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.backend:lint: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check .
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --db-url "$LOCAL_DATABASE_URL" --schema public > frontend/lib/database.types.ts && pnpm -C frontend exec prettier --write lib/database.types.ts
